Main Street Station is a historic Amtrak intermodal station located at **1500 E Main Street, Richmond, Virginia**.

Virginia borders the **Atlantic Ocean**, so the deepest part of that ocean is:

| Ocean | Deepest Point | Depth |
|-------|---------------|-------|
| **Atlantic Ocean** | **Puerto Rico Trench** | ~**8,376 meters** (27,480 feet) below sea level |

Thus, the deepest part of the ocean “by the state where Main Street Station is located” is the **Puerto Rico Trench in the Atlantic Ocean**.
